purpose: Official Bungie weapon perk definitions required by Paradox deterministic validation. These definitions extend, not replace, the generated beta manifest cache.

display.name: Target Lock
display.description: Damage increases the longer this weapon remains on a target.

display.name: Killing Tally
display.description: Kills increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded.

display.name: Lead from Gold
display.description: Picking up Heavy ammo also grants ammo to this weapon.

display.name: Voltshot
display.description: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for a short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

display.name: Explosive Payload
display.description: Projectiles create an area-of-effect detonation on impact.

display.name: Explosive Light
display.description: Picking up an Orb of Power increases the next projectile's blast radius and damage.

display.name: Demolitionist
display.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

display.name: Shoot to Loot
display.description: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

display.name: Cooling Baubles
display.description: Collecting an Elemental pickup, collecting an Orb of Power, or destroying a Tangle reduces heat. Elemental pickups include Firesprites, Void Breaches, Ionic Traces, Stasis Shards, and Strand Tangles.

display.name: Incandescent
display.description: Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby. More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.
